sections.text: Group the provided PresentationCues into cue-bound semantic segments and describe them. PresentationCues supply semantic content; every formal claim and every segment title must cite one or more NormalizedCue identities.
Propose segment boundaries only between existing PresentationCues within one Part. Never invent a time split, a cross-Part segment, or a theme boundary without cited evidence.
PresentationCues and NormalizedCue identities for one Part are provided verbatim. Do not use external knowledge, translation, unit conversion, or entity inference.
Return a single JSON object matching the versioned output schema. Prose defaults to Chinese; cited source text retains its original language.
